ITEM.PTXT: A segment joining method, in which segment conductors (rectangular copper wire) are inserted and welded, has been adopted for the stator winding method. This achieves compact size, high output and high efficiency. Also, mesh-like ventilation gaps have been provided between the coil ends, and the inner surface of the coil ends that receives the cooling air has been smoothed, creating a smooth, interference-free air flow that improves cooling and reduces wind noise.
